a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan means we both almost certainly die in round 1. The reserve only holds 4, so only one of us can be safe right now. I'm going to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than hiding it. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can reach 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry this breaks the plan. If we're still here next round, I'll operate every round until the reserve gets you to 4, and I won't take anything more.
